Elevate your travel routine with this vintage floral jacquard makeup bag. Crafted from premium canvas with an elegant gold floral pattern on a deep green base, this pouch combines timeless style with practical functionality, perfect for organizing cosmetics and toiletries.

Premium Material & Craftsmanship: Made from high-quality durable canvas with intricate jacquard weaving, creating a textured, luxurious finish. The bag features a smooth zipper closure with sturdy pulls, and a soft, lined interior to protect your belongings.

Spacious & Practical Design: Generously sized to hold all your daily cosmetics, skincare products, and travel toiletries. The wide opening allows easy access to your items, while the compact shape fits seamlessly in handbags, luggage, or gym bags.

Versatile Style: The elegant dark green and gold floral design complements vintage, bohemian, oriental, and minimalist aesthetics, making it perfect for travel, daily use, or as a stylish gift.
Easy Care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth, or hand wash gently for long-lasting use. The jacquard fabric resists fading and maintains its shape beautifully.

Size:
26 × 18 × 5 cm (10.2 × 7.1 × 2 inches)

Add a touch of nature to your home with this natural pebble stone drawer knob. Each handle is crafted from genuine stone, making every piece unique in texture, color, and shape, perfect for adding rustic charm to cabinets, dressers, and bedside tables.

The solid stone surface is smooth to the touch yet sturdy for long-lasting use. Paired with a durable brass base, this single-hole pull handle blends functionality with artistry, creating a stylish focal point for furniture.

Ideal for Nordic, farmhouse, and bohemian interiors, this knob works beautifully in kitchens, bedrooms, and living rooms. It’s easy to install and instantly upgrades any furniture with a natural, organic feel.
